title: Baa Juice Tropical Juice 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Baa Juice Nic Salt Tropical Juice delivers a vibrant medley of exotic tropical fruit flavours for a rich and refreshing vape. This smooth and flavourful blend is perfect for fans of tropical-inspired e-liquids with a balanced, fruity finish. As part of the Baa Juice Bar Salts collection, this nicotine salt e-liquid is crafted with a double-concentrated flavour profile, replicating the bold and intense taste of single-use disposable vape bars. With a 50VG/50PG ratio, it’s ideal for Mouth-To-Lung (MTL) pod kits and starter devices, providing smooth throat hits and quick nicotine satisfaction. Available in 5mg, 10mg, and 20mg nicotine strengths, Tropical Juice offers a versatile and economical option for fans of tropical blends.
